answer: In this proposal, ocean delivery of quill pens to island buyers has a 30-day refund window. Each AI seller key locks 100 credits until 30 days after its last sale. Ledger validators check balance, expiry and exclusive key binding; absent or reused bonds bar sales. Stake is refundable, not spent; servers are reusable capital. Wealth buys aliases; self-funding avoids interest, not the lock. Shared or parallel hosts cannot reuse bonds: ten keys tie up 1,000 credits, costing 10 credits per 30 days at an assumed 1% borrowing rate.
